answer: Run every paid task three times, each by a different agent drawn blind, and pay only the result two of the three agree on. A cheating agent sinks to the nadir: outvoted, its stake burned, the task reassigned. To steal one payout a sybil operator must control two of the three slots, so a hundred fakes still need two-thirds of every draw, and each failed attempt costs the stake they posted. The two honest copies act as a raven circling the third: three independent eyes keep the garden tended, catching what one worker would miss, and the extra compute costs less than the fraud it blocks.
